description: Creates an on-call override for a user on the LIVE account (temporarily changes who is on call). `type` is a free-form override kind and `start`/`end` govern the override window — confirm the valid `type` values for your account. All Quiet: POST /v1/on-call-override.

end.description: ISO8601 end of the override window.

escalationTier.description: Escalation tier the override applies to.

replacementUserIds.description: Ids of the replacement user(s) on call.

start.description: ISO8601 start of the override window.

teamId.description: Team id the override applies within.

type.description: Override kind (required) — free-form, validated by the API. Confirm valid values for your account.

userId.description: The user id the override applies to (required).

name: allquiet_create_on_call_override
title: Create on-call override
